rationale: With only 4 minutes to close, any position would be liquidated at market, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that has already dropped ~15% today with a wide effective spread. The last 5 candles show choppy, directionless price action oscillating in a tight range around $58.20-$58.62 with no clear momentum signal to exploit in the remaining time. The risk/reward of entering a position that must be closed at market in under 4 minutes does not justify the execution risk.
